This polygon shapefile is an index to the map series, '五万分一中支空中寫眞測量要圖安徽省石埭黟县地方 -- 1:50,000 Nakashi kūchū shashin sokuryō yōzu Anki-shō' (1940). Stanford University Libraries holds a large collection of Japanese military and imperial maps, referred to as gaihōzu, or 'maps of outer lands.' These maps were produced starting in the early Meiji (1868-1912) era and the end of World War II by the Land Survey Department of the General Staff Headquarters, the former Japanese Army. This layer provides an index map that can be used to locate individual scanned map sheets.
